raw.title: Assistant Sales Manager – Ha Noi

Capable of working independently or in a team and leading and supporting other team members in achieving common goals.

Strong communication and negotiation skills.
Ability to communicate in English (both spoken and written) is an advantage. An English CV is required.
benefits_list: Competitive salary, negotiable during the interview process, with performance-based incentives.

Work Environment & Living Support: Flexible Work Hours: Monthly registration 7:00-16:00, 8:00-17:00 or 9:00-18:00
Comprehensive healthcare and wellness programs.
Opportunities for professional development and technical training.
Flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance.
Professional, collaborative, and innovative working environment.
